input: A 64-bit SoC has a register bank at base address 0x0000_0008_0000_0000 (above 32-bit address space). The IP-XACT addressOffset values are small (< 0x1000) but the baseAddress is 0x800000000. My extractor stores addresses as 32-bit integers and truncates to 0x00000000. How should the extractor handle 64-bit register bank addresses and what data type should address fields use in the graph?
